title: Thousands Rally in Niamey to Back Gen. Tiani After Thwarted Army Mutiny
detail: Several thousand people gathered at Niamey's Place de la Concertation on September 2, 2026, in a show of support for junta leader Gen. Abdourahamane Tchiani (Tiani), days after Russia's Africa Corps helped put down the August 29 mutiny at Base 101. Demonstrators wore T-shirts bearing Tiani's image and waved Russian flags; the crowd included government ministers. Business Minister Abdoulaye Seydou told the rally 'we will show the whole world that the Nigerien people stand united' and that 'treason will not break our determination,' while Gen. Amadou Ibro claimed the mutiny's 'sponsors are based abroad.' Tiani himself had not made a public appearance since the mutiny as of the rally.

sources.name: Africanews — 'Thousands rally to back Niger authorities after thwarted mutiny'
TheCable — 'Thousands rally in Niger capital to back military leader after failed coup'

title: JNIM Claims Overrunning Niamey-Area Checkpoint at Koubia Amid Mutiny Fallout
detail: JNIM claimed it overran a military checkpoint at Koubia, on the western outskirts of Niamey, on September 2, 2026 — days after the failed Base 101 mutiny distracted government forces from active fronts in Niger's Ouallam, Téra, and Dosso departments. The claim, reported by the Critical Threats Project (American Enterprise Institute) in its September 3 Africa File brief, has not been independently corroborated by Niger's government or by Tier 1-2 outlets. Both JNIM and Islamic State-Sahel Province have escalated operations around the capital throughout 2026, with each group separately attacking Base 101 earlier in the year.
